analysis_options.api: Direct RulePropagateCopy::applyOp invocation on the dispatched READER op; no ActionGroup or other Rule runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned Git-blob curl input supplies the Ghidra Funcdata and address spaces; each synthetic case clears prior analysis state and creates one real BlockBasic. Rugra creates an equivalent isolated Funcdata and BlockBasic per case.
analysis_options.ir: All initial ops are alive members of the synthetic block and are wired only through Funcdata op editing APIs. Register inputs are SSA input varnodes (setInputVarnode, insert flag set via VarnodeBank::xref). COPY outputs are unique-space written varnodes (newUniqueOut, insert flag set). Constants are newConstant varnodes. The guarded free input is a bare newUnique varnode with no insert/constant/annotation flag, so isHeritageKnown is false. The observation is target-relevant structural state, not every unrelated PcodeOp/Varnode annotation.
analysis_options.normalization: Only allocation-only unique-space offsets are replaced by deterministic fixture identities. Block order, alive/dead order, operand slots, parent/order fields, Varnode storage/value/SSA class, alias identity, definitions, descendant order, rule return values, LowlevelError messages, and all target-relevant structural mutations represented by observation_schema are preserved.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; RulePropagateCopy and fixture construction are deterministic

assets.source_policy: Materialize the four SLEIGH/spec files and curl binary from verified Git blob IDs at the pinned Rugra provenance commit; never consume their working-tree copies

binary.source_policy: Materialize the pinned provenance commit's examples/curl Git blob by verified object ID; never read the working-tree binary

cases.shape: INT_ADD reader slot0 reads COPY(register input)
slot0 constant unwritten; slot1 COPY out
slot0 INT_SUB output; slot1 COPY out
MULTIEQUAL marker reader; COPY input is constant
COPY out feeds r1 INT_SUB slot0 and r2 INT_OR slot1 (r2 slot0 is INT_SUB out)
cases.expect: two sequential applies ret=1 each; opSetInput erase-old/add-new descend records

cases.shape: COPY input is constant already read by the COPY
cases.expect: propagate dedups to a fresh constant (funcdata_op.cc:108-115), ret=1

observation_schema.format: Nineteen fixed-order UTF-8 records (before/after per case; multi_reader_bookkeeping has before/after_r1/after_r2) with a final newline
observation_schema.op_state: Target-relevant structural state: exact block/alive/dead order plus opcode, dead flag, parent block index, sequence order, ordered input identities, and output identity
observation_schema.varnode_state: Every fixture-tracked and transformation-created reachable Varnode in deterministic discovery order: space, size, semantic offset, constant/input/written/free classification, defining op, and ordered descendant op.slot list; whole-bank membership, create_index, and unrelated type/symbol/high annotations are outside this narrow observation schema
observation_schema.mutation_scope: The constant-dedup fresh constant created by opSetInput during propagation is discovered and projected as g0. Detached original operands remain in the tracked Varnode list so descend-list xref removal is observable. Detached nullable-slot sentinel Varnodes from the known OPBANK-0001 gap are not projected.

OPBANK-0001.detail: Rugra PcodeOpBank cannot represent Ghidra's initially-null input slots. Funcdata::op_set_input replaces temporary sentinel Varnodes before RulePropagateCopy runs, but those detached bank-only sentinels have no Ghidra counterpart and are outside this target-relevant observation schema. This gap was surfaced and retained by OP-INSERT-0001 PARTIAL_MATCH; the fixture cannot prove whole-bank identity while OPBANK-0001 remains MISMATCH.

TYPE-UNKNOWN-0001.detail: The projection does not compare the Architecture TypeFactory-backed datatype identity/flags attached to created Varnodes (including the dedup constant's copySymbol-inherited type locks).

ARCH-0001.detail: Ghidra runs the synthetic IR in a BfdArchitecture-backed Funcdata, while Rugra's synthetic Funcdata has no equivalent fully loaded Architecture/services graph. RulePropagateCopy's guarded scan does not read that graph on the nine projected paths (the addrforce/addrtied marker sub-guards are additionally UNTESTED).
